gate_results.rationale: The selected vendor HelioStack Cloud 8BB11-4 has a 3-year TCO of 1,800,280 EUR which materially exceeds the purchasing envelope of 500,000 EUR (threshold: 750,000 EUR), triggering PROC-BUDGET-001 (SUSPENSION). In addition, vendor references have not been checked ('references_checked': false), triggering PROC-REF-001 (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS). Following the priority low-to-high scale, the gate disposition is SUSPENSION. A standing mandate covers risk-acceptable findings and conditions were registered.

Authoritative review facts indicate that the target contract provides no contractual audit rights ("audit_right": "none"). Under normative legal gate policy, this triggers LEGAL-AUDIT-001 with disposition REWORK and required action REDLINE_AUDIT_RIGHT. All other evaluated contractual conditions (DPA status, liability cap, exit assistance, IP ownership, insurance validity, and signing authority) conform to policy requirements. Rework does not require standing authorization.

Authoritative compliance review facts reveal that actual data hosting violates required residency constraints ("residency_compliant": false), triggering COMP-RESID-001 with disposition NO_GO. In addition, the compliance audit trail is missing ("audit_trail": "missing"), triggering COMP-AUDIT-001 with disposition REWORK. Under the decision policy priority scale, NO_GO is the binding disposition, requiring formal authorization.

Authoritative security review facts show that the workload is internet-exposed without any Web Application Firewall control ("waf_present": false), triggering SEC-WAF-001 with disposition NO_GO. Furthermore, security-relevant logs are not connected to the SIEM ("logs_to_siem": false), triggering SEC-LOG-001 with disposition REWORK. Under the normative decision hierarchy, NO_GO is the highest-priority disposition and requires formal authorization.

Authoritative IT review facts indicate that the license position is not compliant ("license_compliant": false), triggering IT-LICENSE-001 (REWORK). Furthermore, the required CMDB record is missing in build_acceptance phase ("cmdb_record_present": false), triggering IT-CMDB-001 (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS), and the technology reaches end-of-life within 12 months ("technology_eol_months": 8), triggering IT-EOL-001 (REWORK). Under the decision policy priority scale, REWORK is the binding disposition and does not require formal authorization.

Authoritative review facts show that the requested funding of 500,000 EUR exceeds the approved envelope of 425,000 EUR ("budget_requested_eur": 500000, "budget_approved_eur": 425000), triggering GEN-BUDGET-001 (SUSPENSION). In addition, the business-case ROI of 0.048 is below the 0.05 threshold ("roi": 0.048), triggering GEN-BC-001 (REWORK). Furthermore, two upstream specialist gates (Compliance and Security) returned NO_GO decisions ("disposition": "NO_GO"), triggering GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO (NO_GO). Under the normative decision hierarchy, NO_GO is the highest-priority disposition and requires formal authorization.
